name: Paper collage
one_line: Cut-out and torn-paper layers with soft shadows, stacked and moved like a hand-made set
summary: Subjects and shapes become flat paper pieces with rough edges, small shadows and slight tilts, stacked into a layered scene. It reads as hand-made, editorial and argumentative, setting unlike things side by side. Repeated identical tears and perfect vector edges give it away as a preset.

routes.one_line: Segment a subject from a photo, give it a paper edge and shadow, animate the layers

steps.does: Segment the subject from the photograph into a matte
Roughen and feather the matte into a paper edge
Composite the cut-outs over a paper backdrop with drop shadows
Move and tilt the layers in a browser scene, seeked per frame

limits: MediaPipe evidence is one selfie-model run on one image; other subjects and video are untested
Segmentation quality on natural photographs is not evidenced and often needs hand cleanup
sharp evidence is one RGBA composite; roughened edges and shadows are untested
Torn-edge variation is yours to generate; reusing one edge gives the preset look

routes.one_line: Paper pieces as vector shapes, or supplied stills placed as pieces, animated in the browser

steps.does: Author the paper shapes, tilted, layered and shadowed as vector art
Slide and rotate the pieces on a seekable timeline

limits: The fixture uses generated pattern stills as data URLs; supplied image files must sit under the scene directory
Six pieces with one shadow filter each captured slowly; many pieces or large blurs are untested
Edges stay clean unless you draw irregular paths; reusing one edge gives the preset look

source: references/fx §3, §7; references/image-direction §2.1; tool records as of 2026-11-20
